notes.note: Bounded delta review: the built-in cache handoff now passes through the linked-root check (withStationCompileCache options object); a linked or non-directory cache root under the home hands no cache. Token, tenant and caller-credential behavior and the third-party boundary are unchanged; citing pages make no claim about this. No prose change.
